THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE: What do you want, foul vermin?
The very finest? Why waste them on you?
DARV.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPIRE.0-: You lookin’ to get some cheese?
DARV.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPIRE.1-: Still keeping at it, I see... Let’s see if we can upgrade ya!
DARV.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPIRE.2-: So what are ya, some kinda rat?
NONUPEIPE.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPI:
Could a rat truly be worthy of my blessings?
Come forward, GREG, You will be the most beautiful of all rodents.
My dearest thief, let me spoil you.

I wouldn’t typically grant vermin an audience...
Though I suppose you deserve an exception.
What! Clothed rodent?!!! So small!! Why not bigger??

PAEL.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPIRE.1-:
[thinky_dots]What is it like, being another’s prey?
Must be tiring...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPIRE.2-:
[thinky_dots]There is no more food for you here...
Perhaps Father can feed you...[/thinky_dots]

YOU!! TINY WARRIOR!!
FROM WHERE DOES YOUR [jitter]CONFIDENCE[/jitter] SPRING!?

Now how silly would it be if he were unmade by one so unassuming?
You look like you  could use a treat, dearie

Well, don’t be shy.
I have [jitter][b]plenty[/b][/jitter] to spare.

VAKUU.talk.GREGTHESPIRE-GREG_THE_SPIRE.1: How horrid must it be, possessing such [sine]vast[/sine] hunger with so [jitter]small[/jitter] a stomach?
